# LayoutRect

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A single rectangle an element occupied on one page (top-left origin, points).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`height`](#height): Height, in points.
- [`page`](#page): 0-based page index, aligned with `LayoutSnapshot.pages` and SVG page order.
- [`width`](#width): Width, in points.
- [`x`](#x): Left edge, in points.
- [`y`](#y): Top edge, in points from the top of the page.
